ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: Survey design is open-ended generative work, a task family Lapwing strongly prefers (71 vs. Plover's 35). Since the two models' capability evals are within tie-range on the relevant dimensions (Creative Generation 81.2 vs. 82.7 — under the 2.0 variance threshold), preference becomes the reasonable deciding factor, and routing work to the model that prefers it is sensible all else equal.
